notes.title: Bid Wars DLC release date!
notes.notes:
Get ready for the most anticipated release in Barn Finders history! 

Bid Wars DLC is releasing on Steam on 30.09.2022!

New location!
Explore one giant - never seen before, map with auctions on top of auctions, scattered all around the whole map. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/71bd5dcf01e1d47c82ed01e3644785b9a661fc7f.jpg[/img]

New items!
Find loads of new items in each and every new auction! Sell them or take them to your workstation to create some new exotic and bizarre combinations! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/f9afb15e592f05289a95ad3e59067004552caba7.jpg[/img]

And what’s most important! - even more of that sweet sweet pawnin’ yall love so much!
Dive deep into Bid Wars DLC and experience replayability as you’ve never seen before on Barn Finders!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/03f0c29333f63d55673dc79ba01c02ff289c2824.jpg[/img]

Make sure to check it out for yourself on 30.09.2022!

notes.title: Small hotfix (1.02)
notes.notes:
Just a small hotfix to solve problems with native resolutions and blurred main menu.

List of fixes (ver 1.02)
[list]
[*]native resolution not available in the options menu on some monitors - fixed
[*]blurred overlay displayed on top of the main menu - fixed
[*]HUD - inventory not aligned to the bottom of the screen on some resolutions - fixed
[/list]

Have Fun!
